relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a woman with a LAMP2 variant: "Genetic testing (GeneDx, Gaithersburg, MD) revealed a heterozygous novel splice mutation in the LAMP2 gene (c.64+2 T>A)."
method_note: Hand-read; JSON assembled by a short Python script from my own reading (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). Family was screened for the mutation but no results are given, so no relatives and inheritance not reported. Time-dependent findings recorded as separate rows, not treated as contradictions: (1) physical examination at first follow-up 'did not show signs of congestive heart failure' (excluded row) whereas heart failure later developed (checklist heart failure = observed); (2) echocardiogram RV 'normal size and systolic function' (excluded rows) vs later CMR 'RV was dilated and moderately dysfunctional' and later echo 'severe LV and RV dysfunction' (observed rows); (3) childhood VSD that closed spontaneously (observed) vs 'A VSD was not seen'/'There was no VSD' on current imaging (excluded). LV hypertrophy is from the ECG only; CMR maximal wall thickness was 0.8 cm and pathology showed myocyte hypertrophy. Checklist 'proximal muscle weakness' and 'intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties' marked excluded from 'neither cognitive deficiencies nor muscle weakness before or after her heart transplantation'. Discussion statements about LAMP2 cardiomyopathy in males/females in general and about cited cohorts were not used for this person. Vital status 'alive' from discharge home after transplantation. 'She was treated for pneumonia' not recorded as a feature (diagnosis not confirmed).
